scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from published Type-A characterization, complete three-interval classification, finite graph and pivot verification. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: The result counts pairwise-confusability triangles, not triples with two globally shared descendants or optimal reconstruction-code sizes. Unindexed equivalent results are possible. The original 2001 paper was inspected only via public abstract and bibliographic record.
title: Canonical classification and exact triangle census for two-read deletion graphs
